goal: Decide if Prism-DevRel may publish its pages, so no reader ever sees a page that gets the model wrong.

app.name: devrel-gate
app.title: Publish gate
app.purpose: Decide whether the learning catalog is published, regenerated, or refused, from the records no page covers, the covers that name an undeclared resource, and whether the catalog matches the pinned subject commit.

fields.name: undeclared
fields.means: covers that name an undeclared resource

fields.name: pin
fields.means: whether the committed catalog is the pinned commit's

meanings.publish: the pages workflow publishes the catalog
meanings.regenerate: not published: the catalog must be regenerated from the pinned commit with devrel-catalog
meanings.refuse: not published: the catalog misstates the subject

rules.why: README DR-02: a catalog with an undeclared resource is refused (Catalog::undeclaredResourceRefused)
README DR-01 and DR-02: every facet record is covered (Catalog::catalogCovered, uncoveredRecordRefused)
.github/workflows/pages.yml DR-03: devrel-catalog --check fails when the committed catalog is not the pinned commit's

app.otherwiseWhy: complete, declared and current: the pages workflow publishes

stakeholders.name: Developer
stakeholders.text: Learns Prism from the catalog and needs every page to state only what the subject declares.

stakeholders.name: DevRel author
stakeholders.text: Writes the pages and needs a publish to fail while any record is untaught.

concerns.name: Catalog follows its pin
concerns.text: The committed catalog is the catalog of exactly the commit devrel/subject.json pins, DR-03.

components.name: UORust subject
components.text: The subject model, afflom/uorust app/, fetched at the full commit devrel/subject.json pins.

components.name: devrel-catalog
components.text: crates/devrel: reads every .lex.tex module of the subject and writes app/src/Catalog.lex.tex and the learning pages.

threats.name: Pin moved without regenerating
threats.text: devrel/subject.json is moved to a new commit and the old catalog is published as if it taught the new one.

control.name: Catalog checked against its pin
control.text: pages.yml regenerates the catalog from the pinned commit and fails on any difference; a stale pin is never published, proved for every request.

threats.name: Fabricated cover
threats.text: A page claims to cover a resource the catalog does not declare.

control.name: Declared covers only
control.text: A cover naming an undeclared resource refuses the catalog, in the Lean catalog and in this app.

threats.name: Subject commit substituted
threats.text: The fetched subject is not the commit the pin names.

control.name: Full commit fetched
control.text: pages.yml fetches the pinned full commit and checks rev-parse HEAD equals it before building the catalog.

quality.text: Every facet record of the pinned subject is covered by at least one learning resource before the catalog is published.
quality.measureText: Facet records of the subject no resource covers.
